questions: Were all CLI changes implemented per the plan?
Does the dual heading regex support both HTML and Markdown?

answers.answer: Yes. All 3 plan steps (L1-L3) were implemented: filePath added to local type, HTML heading regex added before Markdown fallback, TypeScript compilation passes.

Yes. The HTML regex /<h([1-6])(?:\s+[^>]*?id="([^"]*)"[^>]*)?>(.+?)<\/h\1>/i is tried first. It extracts level, id attribute, and text (stripping nested HTML tags). If it doesn't match, the original Markdown regex /^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/ is used as fallback. Both produce the same output format.
evidence: show.ts lines 48-66: HTML pattern with continue
show.ts lines 70-85: Markdown fallback (unchanged from original)

answers.answer: Yes. npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors.

statement: All CLI changes for dual-format heading extraction have been implemented per the plan. The HTML heading regex is tried first with Markdown as fallback. Zero new runtime dependencies. TypeScript compilation passes.
